blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: pass — One traversal of the remaining unsorted section.
comparison — Test used to determine whether a swap is required.
early exit — Stop when a pass makes no swaps.

blocks.title: Compare neighbours
blocks.text: Compare positions j and j+1. Swap only if the earlier value is greater.

blocks.title: Finish one pass
blocks.text: The greatest unsorted value moves to the right-hand end of the unsorted section.

blocks.title: Repeat less work
blocks.text: Each completed pass fixes one final position; an entire pass with no swaps proves the array is sorted.
